sort_rule: Earliest to latest death year, ascending from bottom to top. For ancient, traditional, or unknown death dates, use clearly labeled approximate last documented period or historical placement; never represent an approximate proxy as a proven death date.
historical_caveat: Portraits are original product illustrations, not authenticated likenesses of pre-photographic figures. The exhibition's death-year arrangement does not imply that a person's contributions happened in the year of death. Dates and special cases require further individual source checks.
